decision: Limited revision-pinned offline evaluation of dayz-script-validator only; do not install, register, or adopt MCP from this assessment. A later disposable no-registration MCP smoke is separately scoped and coordinator-dispatched under standing isolated-test authorization.

corrections.decision: Scope 1.29.163709 / Scripts Rev. 125372 to Script Diff commit 86974a0…0a1 and 1.29.0.163709 to the current executable; treat extraction files as hashable snapshots, not wholesale build attribution.
MCP manifests declare mcp==1.27.2, Pillow==12.2.0, psutil==7.2.2; no install or resolution receipt exists.
Both layout FAILs are detector false positives for the guarded optional probe; detectors lack namespace, use-site, and guard/control-flow analysis.
Five exact-GetType warnings are semantic-review candidates; exact contracts may be intentional, so do not prescribe IsKindOf without per-site review.
find/show/status are read-only; dayz_knowledge_prepare writes and publishes an index.
Vanilla-control FAIL is expected tree/baseline drift, not compile/runtime failure.
Multi-PBO scan PASS covers eight files as a zero-finding static candidate scan only; no dependency/packing/signing/runtime proof. The 157 tests are offline fixture/unit coverage.
Retain no-adoption; future isolated MCP smoke is separately coordinator-dispatched, disposable, no-registration, and requires external-state before/after evidence; no new permission gate.
